messages:
maya: incident-bot just paged for tenant=borealis -- high p50/p95 request latency and increased 503s. getting PD critical. anyone on shift?
incident-bot: PagerDuty — Triggered: Critical — borealis_reserved_capacity_high_latency — service: dedicated-reservations — Pager: oncall@redwood.com — link: https://pd.example/INC-4312
pd-bot: Pager acknowledged by maya at 14:03 UTC :white_check_mark:
maya: acked. starting triage. impact: dedicated cluster 'borealis-1' showing queue saturation and >20% 503s for reserved-tenant requests. support ticket #CS-8921 opened; Alejandra pinged the customer.
alejandra (support): i messaged Borealis SRE: "We're investigating elevated latency and 503s, will update in 15m". they confirm spike started ~13:58 UTC.
lin (sre): looking at autoscaler and router metrics now. seeing many short-lived single-token requests — very chatty -> can't batch effectively. Kube nodes at 93% GPU memory utilization, pod restart count increasing.
devon (infra): checking reserved pool controller. there's a recent rollout to autoscaler v2, but no config drift alerts. autoscaler shows scale attempts stuck with failed node provisioning 50% of the time. possibly GC/instance quota throttling in region us-west2.
maya: can we triage whether this is capacity or routing? if capacity, we need to temporary increase reserved cap or redirect to fallback pool. if routing, maybe fall back to hosted variant.
lin (sre): stack traces show queue backlog in inference-proxy, 2s tail latency for batching window. logs: ```
[2026-03-15T14:02:59Z] WARN request_queue.go:142 backlog_size=374 tenant=borealis
[2026-03-15T14:03:05Z] ERROR handler.go:88 upstream=dedicated-infer timeout=GPU-bottleneck
```
lin: also seeing KV cache evictions spike — likely memory churn from many short sequences.
devon: region API shows provisioning errors: `QuotaExceeded: could not allocate new instance` for instance type a2-highmem. raising infra page to cloud team.
maya: immediate mitigations: 1) enable temporary soft-fallback routing for borealis to a compatible hosted model (lower throughput but avoids 503s), 2) throttle/shape incoming burst via rate-limiter, 3) request customer to postpone large batch jobs. any objections?
tess (product): fallback routing might degrade QoE for Borealis; they expect <150ms. but better than 503s. they prefer we keep them on dedicated if possible.
lin: I'll flip fallback policy to allow routing to hosted-compat for this tenant. command: ```
# enable tenant fallback
redwoodctl tenants update borealis --fallback-hosted=true --fallback-max-qps=200
```
lin: applied. watch logs.
(30s later)
lin: hosted fallback is receiving traffic — initial 30qps. 503s on dedicated down to 6%, overall errors for tenant down from 22% -> 4%. p50 latency for tenant (hosted+dedicated) ~180ms.
maya: good. still need infra to resolve provisioning; sustained fallback will cost more. devon, status on quota request?
devon: cloud quota request approved for +3 a2 instances but there is a 12–15 minute warmup. I'm initiating immediate node replacement and bumping reserved pool size once nodes are available.
alejandra: Borealis acknowledged observing improvements and asked for ETA and mitigation steps. i told them fallback is active and we're provisioning nodes; will update in 15m.
lin: follow-up: I see persistent KV eviction noise; once nodes land, we should increase KV cache size for borealis pods to reduce churn: ```
redwoodctl config set tenant.borealis.kv_cache_size=12Gi
```
maya: please prepare a post-incident note: timeline, root cause hypoth — spike of single-token chatty QPS + cloud quota hiccup during autoscaler rollout -> routing backlog -> KV churn -> 503s. Include cost impact with fallback.
devon: infra note — autoscaler v2 had an edge-case where provisioning failures weren't retried aggressively for preemptible pools. submitted a hotfix PR to retry loops.
(5m)
incident-bot: PagerDuty — Escalation: Not acknowledged by second-level; notifying SRE lead.
maya: I'm on it. looped in Lin and Devon, and SRE lead is aware.
lin: after node add, dedicated pool utilization back to 68%. 503s for dedicated nodes down to 1.2%. KV eviction rate normalized.
maya: closing PD incident? we should let it settle 10m.
devon: added a temporary quota guard to block autoscaler from attempting >X scale events if region quota errors spike. will follow up with cloud ops on permanent guardrails.
alejandra: customer posted: "Thanks for quick response — saw errors drop substantially. Keeping us posted on ETA for full return to dedicated."
maya: thanks team. I'll mark the incident as resolved in the ticket once we have 10m stable and then do a short war-room writeup.
(10m later)
maya: stable for 12m, closing PD incident and updating CS ticket. action items: - infra: finalize retry hotfix and quota guard (devon) - runtime: KV cache param change and batching tuning (lin) - product: communicate SLA implications for fallback (tess) - support: follow up with Borealis and log customer impact numbers (alejandra)
pd-bot: Incident resolved by maya at 14:25 UTC :white_check_mark:
